reviews.text: This place is fantastic. Every now and then, I pamper my cat Max here at Magic, and he always comes home looking good and smells lovely. Although my furry baby sometimes gives them hell, they always work around his tantrum and send him all cute. I recommend Magic Grooming & Pet Resort 10/10
Before and after Zoë looks great!

First time taking my 10 month old puppy to Magic Grooming Pet & Resort for a full service and a total disappointment. When I went to look for him I saw him shaking and hiding, I felt something bad happened. He didn't eat for two days. He didn't bark, he was sad, scared and his genitals were irritated. He wasn't literally my happy everyday dog! I made my claim to show me the cameras and I'm still waiting for their response. Please! If you love your pets DO NOT TAKE THEM TO THIS PLACE!!! I went in August 2024.

Made an appointment for 9:00 am showed up at 8:45 am as I was told if I did that he would be the first dog. They told me he would be ready by 12:00 or before. At 12:15pm they called me to tell me they were running late and he wouldn’t be ready until 1:30pm. When I arrived to the location they told me to bring him back during the week because they could get two knots out. The haircut was bad not what I asked for and the dog was stressed out. Not what I have experienced at other grooming places. Also when they called initially they told her not in a crate but in the patio outside! My dog is kitten and outside did. When I asked then why he would be outside they retracted and said he was not and that they were playing with him the entire time. I would never trust this establishment with my dog again.

Kingsley deserved better!!!!

Do NOT leave your pet in there care. Worse place ever.
Kingsley died on April 19th, 2024 in their care and they were negligent in getting him the attention he needed when they knew we needed help.

They didn’t provide water to him after he had been there for over an hour and half after I asked when I dropped him off.

KINGSLEY DESERVED BETTER!!!

This groomer killed a dog. They had over an hour to get help for him but instead YELLED AT HIM WHILE HE WAS HAVING A SEIZURE!  Didn’t provide water even after knowing he was in distress. Didn’t call his owner until he had been in distress for an hour. They could have saved him! RIP KINGSLEY! Please don’t take your pet here!

I have been coming here as a repeat/loyal customer for a long time, then the UNTHINKABLE happened. I left my dog there to get groomed and when I picked him up he was limping. I looked at his paw and it looked like a wound that was cleaned up and masked to look like nothing happened. The next morning, his paw had this visible aftermath of the wound. I brought my dog back and confronted them. Of course they denied it. All of a sudden all of them came from the back and all showed “sympathy” but did not take accountability at all. They were quick to say “that didn't happen here”. “We don’t have tools here that could cause that”. etc…One of the ladies actually said “Oh my god, I didnt do that, I did nothing” Complete obvious of guilt, but still denying it. One of them also had the audacity to say “Maybe he stepped on a cigarette butt” Who the hell says something like that??!! Did they even offer a refund? No. But they did say “Omg, please keep us updated we are so sorry” after I told them I was taking him to the VET to get some real answers. It’s unfortunate because real professionals would of at least taken accountability, but no, they did not. The thought of how loud my dog probably cried/screamed when they did this to him fills me with ANGER and PAIN. The trust they broke is something im sure means nothing to them. BEWARE! Next time you take your pet there, make sure you look at every inch of your pet before exiting that place because you might see signs of them hurting your loved ones. Our pets are not mere property or objects that you can just injure and cover up. Our pets are family. If our pets can talk, who knows how much they would have to say about Magic Grooming.

Very disappointed in the way this location failed to follow their protocols when an emergency situation happened with a family members dog, who is now deceased. Not blaming them for the issue that arose but we are deeply upset as they were negligent in making sure he received emergency care he needed, in a timely manne.
I have been taking my fur baby here to get bathed since i got her around 6 months ago. Cynthia is amazing with my fur baby and always leaves her extra beautiful. Cynthia deserves 10 stars.
